data.gender_notes: Adarsh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Adarsh means ideal or model in Sanskrit. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'adarsa', which means 'sight' or 'vision'. Adarsh is a name that signifies perfection and is often given to a child who is considered to be a role model or ideal in some way. The name Adarsh carries the meaning “Ideal, Model” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Adarsh usually hope their child will grow to embody ideal, model and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the ideal of moral and ethical conduct, inspiring one to strive for perfection and goodness.
data.etymology: Adarsh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ideal, Model.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adarsh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
